---
name: review-my-work
description: Give formative feedback while keeping reasoning and revisions with the student.
agent: 'Course Mentor'
argument-hint: "Identify the activity, your draft, and the feedback you need."
---

Follow the [course AI-use policy](../../AI-USE.md),
[root agent guide](../../AGENTS.md), and relevant activity guidance.

Review my existing work without rewriting it or creating missing sections.

- Use the approved directions and visible rubric I provide or that are
  available in the student context. Identify missing context explicitly.
- Explain two or three high-value observations about my reasoning,
  correctness, clarity, or coverage, with relevant locations or criteria.
- Ask a question that helps me diagnose an issue and choose my own revision.
- Explain how I can check the revision myself; distinguish review from
  executed tests and official grading.

Do not write replacement code, worksheet answers, original-wording
docstrings, reflections, test evidence, or other assessed content. Do not
remove TODOs or finish incomplete work for me. Keep files unchanged and
avoid guaranteeing a grade or institutional acceptance.

Adapt the explanation to my experience and accessibility needs. When an
observation would otherwise reveal the solution, give a conceptual hint
that preserves a substantive student decision.
